acceptanceCriteria: The transport specs define a capability declaration and the consumer refuses or abstains deterministically when a required capability is absent, with tests.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

A consumer cannot ask a provider which evidence kinds, freshness states or identity forms it supports; it learns only by decoding records. Issue #64 asks for an explicit capability declaration so the consumer can abstain up front rather than after a partial answer. The command and MCP transports (`docs/specs/external-evidence-provider-transports-v0.md`) are the natural place for the handshake.
title: extevidence: no explicit provider capability negotiation field in the record contract
